ticker: BTC $75,871 · ETH $2,238 · XRP $1.18 · SOL $90.12 · 128 SHINKIN BANKS OFFLINE IN WESTERN JAPAN

head: 128 BANKS
*OFFLINE IN JAPAN*
scenes.say: One hundred twenty eight banks in Japan went offline at once. A T Ms, counters and online banking, all frozen.

head: WHY?
*ONE DATA CENTER*
*FAILED*
scenes.say: Why? A hardware fault at one shared data center in western Japan. Officials say there are no signs of a cyberattack.

head: NOT A COLLAPSE
*A SYSTEM FAILURE*
scenes.say: To be clear, these banks did not go bust. The money is there. People just could not reach it.

head: AGAIN
*3RD BIG OUTAGE*
*SINCE 2023*
scenes.say: And it keeps happening. A two day payment outage in twenty twenty three, and a hundred forty credit co-ops down this January.

head: ONE SERVER
*OR THOUSANDS*
*OF NODES?*
scenes.note: SEND THIS TO A FRIEND WHO HOLDS BTC
scenes.say: Bitcoin runs on thousands of independent computers, with no single center to fail. One server, or thousands of nodes? Not financial advice, just data.
